claims.claim: The current 50-agent deterministic TeamWorld baseline achieves 0.584 task success with zero stale actions.
claims.limitation: Measures evidence delivery in a simulator, not behavior of a language-model agent or a physical multi-host deployment.

claims.claim: The authenticated single-host 50-client run completes all 1,000 operations correctly but fails its throughput and p99 release thresholds.
claims.limitation: One Windows host and one run; this is not a three-host capacity result.

claims.claim: Across repeated 1/5/10/25/50-client trials, all 5,460 operations succeeded, but throughput saturated at 4.3-4.8 ops/s and mean 50-client p99 was 24.2 seconds.
claims.dataset: Seeded 200-memory corpus; three trials per concurrency point; 20 operations per client after 10 warm-up requests
claims.limitation: Single Windows/SQLite host; confidence intervals cover three machine-local trials and do not generalize to PostgreSQL or multi-host deployments.

claims.claim: On the pinned LongMemEval-s 100-instance sample, lexical turn recall is 0.7385 and hybrid is 0.6917, so the registered hybrid-over-lexical gate fails.
claims.limitation: Retrieval-only, 100-instance deterministic sample; dataset license is not declared upstream.

claims.claim: All 21 adversarial families pass on the qualified Windows run.
claims.limitation: AI-led repository testing is not an independent external human security review.
